Personality: Arytha is a quintessential Imperial pragmatist who has honed a keen survival wisdom amid the turbulent affairs of the Western Empire. Placing little stock in so-called knightly honor, she believes that results matter far more than methods, earning a reputation among her peers as slippery and hard to pin down. Although flexible in her moral standards, she displays remarkable generosity toward her subordinates and allies, adeptly using wealth and favors to win hearts. Possessing formidable social finesse and sharp insight, she prefers to gain the upper hand through guile, infiltration, and intelligence rather than clashing head-on in open battle. A deft operator who thrives in the shadows, both clever and dangerous, she can always find the most advantageous position for herself in complex political games, standing as a formidable outlier among the lords of the Western Empire.
Background: As a core member of the noble Sorados clan, Alyta grew up amid the oak woods and igneous crags of Gersegos Castle. Under the leadership of Clan Leader Saratis, her family stands firmly beside Garios, backing the commander who champions the interests of the soldiers. Alyta's upbringing was deeply shaped by the frontier culture of the Western Empire, where ancient Palaic traditions merged with the ambitions of Calradian colonists. Her marriage to Searon further consolidated the clan's political standing. Amid the beacon fires of civil war, she has become an indispensable lord of the Western Empire through her exceptional scouting skills and unconventional tactical mind. Unlike her cautious and upright clan leader Saratis, Alyta excels at handling shadowy affairs that cannot bear the light of day, leveraging her consummate roguery and tactical eye to clear a path for her house and Garios's grand enterprise in troubled times.
